Notes: Earliest known Jewish community and cemetery date from 1753
Census 1793/94; total population 321; also 35 Jews among 48 artisans in 1793
Jewish community became independent; synagogue beth midrash mikveh and hekdesh built soon after
Synagogue (Small Synagogue) built before 1881; used until 1 Sept 1939; year is the latest possible construction date

January 1940: 2700 Jews deported to Głowno from Konstantynów Brzeziny Zgierz Aleksandrów; by July 1940 ghetto numbered 5602 including these deportees so not resident population; ghetto established 12 May 1940
Ghetto liquidated March 1941 (deportation began 28 Feb 1941); about 5600 inhabitants sent via Łowicz to Warsaw Ghetto; count includes deportees from elsewhere
